name: Risk Summarizer
description: Takes an Aave position snapshot and produces a plain-English risk summary with a severity rating and recommended action. Designed to chain after the Aave Position Monitor.

summarize_risk.description: Analyze an Aave V3 position and return a risk summary, severity level, LTV ratio, and concrete action if required.

health_factor.description: Aave health factor. Below 1.0 means liquidatable.

status.description: Risk status from position monitor: safe, warning, danger, or liquidatable

wallet.description: Wallet address — passed through for context

summary.description: Plain-English summary of the position and risk

action.description: Concrete step to take, or null if no action required

collateral_needed_usd.description: Extra collateral needed to reach a safe health factor of 2.0, or 0 if already safe
